title: Inference buyers' narrative and competitive mosaic research
creator: Ava Chen
description: Synthesize qualitative and quantitative signals about enterprise buyers' decision criteria for inference providers. Output a narrative and mosaic that maps buyer priorities (latency, cost, SLA, data residency, quantization support, vendor lock risk) to competing offerings and emergent open-model trajectories. This ticket funds the research sprint: 1) interview 8 field-facing reps and 6 pilot customers, 2) assemble a small benchmark of latency/cost for 10 model+deployment permutations, 3) create decision heuristics for procurement and a prioritized playbook for integrating fallback models.
acceptance_criteria: Research narrative (1-2 page) summarizing buyer personas and top-3 procurement triggers
Competitive mosaic visual (PNG + alt text) mapping 6 buyer criteria against 8 provider/model combos
A prioritized list of 5 procurement playbook actions (with estimated impact and effort)
Data appendix: raw field interview notes + latency/cost benchmark CSV + link to dashboards
deliverables: Buyer narrative doc (Confluence) - sections: context, personas, triggers, quotes
Competitive mosaic - visual and summary slide deck
Benchmark workbook (BigQuery/CSV) and instruction notebook for reproducing tests
Procurement playbook - prioritized actions and owner assignments
Signal instrumentation spec for ongoing model-landscape tracking (event types + thresholds)
risks: Field interviews may skew toward existing customers with positive bias
Benchmark cost figures vary by region and instance type; may not generalize
Competitive public info for private deployments is sparse; requires inference from procurement docs
